notes.title: Update 3.2.4 - new zoom feature + improvements
notes.content:
[b]You can now zoom out the view using CTRL + SCROLL WHEEL.[/b]

It is now possible to see much more of the work area than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37294984/2af48d1ec66ed8714b6f0c7d51ff6802bdc4d088.png[/img]

It is still recommended to reset the view when editing nodes by pressing the circular arrow icon in the top-right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37294984/4005412cb14968445a52b51e5ea23ae353eed363.png[/img]


[b]Additionaly, scrolling is now much smoother (hold SHIFT when scrolling to pan the view horizontally).[/b]


The update is live now so go check it out!

notes.title: Dialogue Designer is Now Available!
notes.content:
Finally, here it is! Get it now if you haven't already.

Few important notes:
[list]
[*] If you have any feedback you want to share, please contact me by email or on social media or make a new post so we can work together on making the software even better!
[*] Please don't hesitate to leave an honest review. Though, if you find any bugs, please contact me first (by email) so I can fix them. 
[*] The software has been designed to be as easy to use and understandable as possible, though it is advised to read the manual before starting: [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1273620/manuals/Dialogue_Designer_Documentation.pdf?t=1587163809]Dialogue Designer manual[/url]
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who supported the software so far!
radmatt
